reason: This request is for an analog/high-voltage electrical engineering design (a Tesla coil) rather than a digital logic circuit. Please submit a digital logic design (e.g., counter, UART, FSM, ALU) that can be implemented in Verilog or VHDL.
prompt:
Design a small tabletop spark-gap Tesla coil (SGTC) for education/demo, targeting
~15–20 cm spark output from a 9 kV / 30 mA neon-sign-transformer supply.

Produce:
1. A block diagram of the full chain: mains → NST (HV supply) → MMC tank
   capacitor → static spark gap → primary tank coil → secondary coil → toroid topload,
   with RF ground.
2. The resonant design with equations AND worked numbers: secondary inductance &
   self-capacitance, target resonant frequency, then the matching primary LC (tank
   cap value + primary turns) tuned to the same frequency.
3. A component/BOM table with representative values: NST rating, MMC cap bank
   (series/parallel, voltage rating), spark-gap geometry, secondary turns & wire
   gauge, primary turns/spacing, toroid dimensions.
4. Key safety notes: HV isolation, RF grounding vs mains ground, and an interlock.

Keep it a single buildable ~20 cm-spark unit — not an industrial coil.
